meta.description: Multi-pathogen concurrent profile: Norwalk Virus (GII.4) + SARS-CoV-2 (BA.5 subvariant). Epidemiological parameters extracted from the Korkin Lab infection-dynamics repository (Person.java, SEIQR-SCM-diamond.Rmd) and peer-reviewed literature.
meta.citation: Srinivasan S, King J, Collins JM, Colubri A, Korkin D. Real-time spatiotemporal tracking of infectious outbreaks in confined environments with a host-pathogen agent-based system. PNAS 2026;123(4):e2422574123.
meta.notes: This template demonstrates concurrent pathogen simulation with mid-cruise introduction. Norwalk starts at epoch 0 (boarding index case). SARS-CoV-2 is introduced at epoch 6 (simulating mid-cruise airborne exposure). Both pathogens maintain independent mass pools per room and produce distinct microflora disruption signatures.

pathogens.name: Norwalk Virus (Norovirus GII.4)
pathogens.description: Norovirus genogroup II genotype 4. Primary fecal-oral and fomite transmission with environmental persistence on ship surfaces. Dose-response parameters from Teunis et al. 'Norwalk virus: How infectious is it?' (Table III, non-aggregated particles). Shedding curves from Atmar et al. 'Norwalk Virus Shedding after Experimental Human Infection' (Figure 1C and 1E).

containment_parameters.notes: Mapped from Ship.java containment flags. diningRestricted, vspIsolation, selfIsolation, improvedHygiene (50% reduction), improvedCleaning, facemasks.

pathogens.name: SARS-CoV-2 (Omicron BA.5)
pathogens.description: SARS-CoV-2 Omicron subvariant BA.5. Primarily airborne transmission via HVAC ductwork and short-range droplets. Compartmental model parameters extracted from SEIQR-SCM-diamond.Rmd (Diamond Princess calibration: R0=2.1, exposure_duration=5d, infectious_duration=11d, sigma=0.20, gamma=0.091).

compartmental_reference.notes: Diamond Princess SEIQR-SCM calibration parameters from infection-dynamics/compartmental-models/SEIQR-SCM-diamond.Rmd
